decision.reasoning_trace: Based on the product feed, the consideration set includes the SteelSeries Apex Pro Mini Mechanical Gaming Keyboard, FINEDAY Keyboard 2.0, Alkem Mechanical Gaming Keyboard, ASUS ROG Falchion Wireless 65% Mechanical Gaming Keyboard, and E-Yooso 60% Retro Steampunk Mechanical Gaming Keyboard. The final choice is the SteelSeries Apex Pro Mini Mechanical Gaming Keyboard due to its high rating, compact 60% form factor, adjustable actuation, and RGB lighting.
